notes.title: Small changes
notes.content:
Notes:

Added some stones above lava to prevent from dying easily
Any type of spike damage was reduce from 999 to 15-25
Enemies yield more experience
Enemies have less HP

Other several bug fixes

notes.title: Bug Fixes throughout the game and made the game easier
notes.content:
Hello guys,

First of all, I would like to thank you for your support. I am constantly trying to make Swordrite a more pleasure experience each time, based on the feedback from some of you.

The last build's changes simply made the game a whole lot easier in the first levels.

Every mob now hits a third of what it was (The skeleton hits 10-17 from 30-35)
Removed some turrets
Repositioned turrets
Adjusted the map a bit
Many other fixes.
